fields.Name: T298 - Integrations Activity Run Detail Tabs
fields.Description: Exercises the SelectRun right-detail panel with SetDetailTab entity/watermarks tab switching (and lazy watermark load) — distinct from the accordion inline expand covered by the drilldown test (T196).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Activity' section. In the run list, find a run row and click its detail-panel toggle button (the table-columns / split-view icon in the row's actions). Verify a right-hand detail panel opens showing the run's integration name, status chip, a duration bar, and two tabs: 'Entity Breakdown' and 'Watermarks'. Click the 'Watermarks' tab and confirm the content switches to a watermarks table (or a 'No watermarks recorded' empty state), then click back to 'Entity Breakdown'. Seeing the tabbed detail panel and tab switching is success. If there are no runs, the 'No runs found' empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a run's detail toggle opens a right-hand panel with the run's status chip and a duration bar
The panel shows 'Entity Breakdown' and 'Watermarks' tabs, and clicking Watermarks switches the panel content (table or empty state)
OR a valid 'no runs' empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
